description: This file contains utility functions for AAudio, including conversions between AAudio and Android audio formats, status code mappings, channel mask conversions, property retrieval functions, and policy handling, used within the Android audio framework.

methods.name: AAudioConvert_aaudioToAndroidStatus
methods.description: Converts an aaudio_result_t code to an Android status_t code.

methods.name: AAudioConvert_androidToAAudioResult
methods.description: Converts an Android status_t code to an aaudio_result_t code.

methods.name: AAudioConvert_aaudioToAndroidSessionId
methods.description: Converts an aaudio_session_id_t to an Android audio_session_t.

methods.name: AAudioConvert_aaudioToAndroidDataFormat
methods.description: Converts an aaudio_format_t to an Android audio_format_t.

methods.name: AAudioConvert_androidToAAudioDataFormat
methods.description: Converts an Android audio_format_t to an aaudio_format_t.

methods.name: AAudioConvert_androidToNearestAAudioDataFormat
methods.description: Converts an Android audio_format_t to the nearest supported aaudio_format_t.

methods.name: AAudioConvert_usageToInternal
methods.description: Maps an aaudio_usage_t to internal audio usage, defaulting to media if unspecified.

methods.name: AAudioConvert_contentTypeToInternal
methods.description: Maps an aaudio_content_type_t to internal content type, defaulting to music if unspecified.

methods.name: AAudioConvert_inputPresetToAudioSource
methods.description: Maps an aaudio_input_preset_t to internal audio source.

methods.name: AAudioConvert_computeAudioFlagsMask
methods.description: Computes an audio flags mask based on various input policies and flags.

methods.name: AAudioConvert_privacySensitiveToAudioFlagsMask
methods.description: Returns privacy-sensitive capture flag.

methods.name: AAudioConvert_aaudioToAndroidChannelLayoutMask
methods.description: Converts an aaudio_channel_mask_t to Android channel layout mask for input or output.

methods.name: AAudioConvert_androidToAAudioChannelLayoutMask
methods.description: Converts an Android channel mask to an aaudio_channel_mask_t for input or output.

methods.name: AAudioConvert_channelMaskToCount
methods.description: Counts the number of channels in an aaudio_channel_mask_t.

methods.name: AAudioConvert_channelCountToMask
methods.description: Creates a channel mask from a channel count.

methods.name: AAudioConvert_androidToAAudioChannelIndexMask
methods.description: Converts an Android index channel mask to an aaudio_channel_mask_t.

methods.name: AAudioConvert_aaudioToAndroidChannelIndexMask
methods.description: Converts an aaudio_channel_mask_t index mask to Android channel mask.

methods.name: AAudioConvert_androidToAAudioChannelMask
methods.description: Converts an Android channel mask to an aaudio_channel_mask_t, considering index and layout masks.

methods.name: AAudioConvert_aaudioToAndroidChannelMask
methods.description: Converts an aaudio_channel_mask_t to Android channel mask, considering input/output.

methods.name: AAudio_isChannelIndexMask
methods.description: Checks if an aaudio_channel_mask_t is an index mask.

methods.name: AAudio_getChannelMaskForOpen
methods.description: Determines the appropriate channel mask for opening a stream based on parameters.

methods.name: AAudioConvert_framesToBytes
methods.description: Calculates byte size from frame count and bytes per frame, with overflow checks.

methods.name: AAudioProperty_getWakeupDelayMicros
methods.description: Retrieves wakeup delay in microseconds, with clipping.

methods.name: AAudioProperty_getMinimumSleepMicros
methods.description: Retrieves minimum sleep duration in microseconds, with clipping.

methods.name: AAudioProperty_getMMapOffsetMicros
methods.description: Retrieves mmap offset in microseconds for input/output.

methods.name: AAudioProperty_getInputMMapOffsetMicros
methods.description: Retrieves input mmap offset in microseconds.

methods.name: AAudioProperty_getOutputMMapOffsetMicros
methods.description: Retrieves output mmap offset in microseconds.

methods.name: AAudioProperty_getLogMask
methods.description: Retrieves log mask property.

methods.name: AAudio_isFlushAllowed
methods.description: Checks if flushing is allowed in the current stream state.

methods.name: AAudio_getAAudioPolicy
methods.description: Determines AAudio policy based on a list of policy info objects.
